answer_text:
Published research does not specify a single exact numerical count of different web domains cited by Perplexity for local business recommendation questions.
Source: A September 2026 study titled "ChatGPT and Perplexity agreed on only 1 in 4 local business recommendations" published by Clicks Dynasty (conducted by SEO specialist Ravinder Cheema).
What the Study Found: The research tested 20 local business queries across five California cities and four industries (yielding 100 total recommendations per AI engine). Instead of tracking an exact total domain tally, the study noted that Perplexity heavily favored crediting the business's own website for roughly half of its 99 picks, followed by local directories and Yelp. www.clicksdynasty.com +1
Would you like more details on the overlap percentage between ChatGPT and Perplexity in that study, or information on how Perplexity sources local listings compared to Google?
